sentences.en: Many of their wetland habitats are being affected by mining.
sentences.zh: 许多他们的湿地栖息地正受到采矿的影响。

sentences.en: Forested wetlands are the subject of extensive USDA research.
sentences.zh: 森林沼泽是美国农业部广泛研究的对象。

sentences.en: Wetlands can have freshwater, salt water, or a mixture of both.
sentences.zh: 湿地可以有淡水、盐水或两者的混合物。
